The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.
Due to Sultanate of Aussa not having anything of value, it's advisable to release Aussa as ⟦0⟧ when playing as ⟦1⟧.

Surviving the inevitable war with Italy is possible, and can lead to the player going into WW2 with a very capable and elite fighting force. First you must withdraw your small starting army to your capital in the mountains as trying to defend in the desert will lead to equipment and manpower losses that you can not absorb. Your industry is non existent, with only a single military factory and no civilian factories. Take the military focus path beginning with "The Afar Armed Forces" for 35 days and once complete use the army XP to add four units of regular infantry to the irregulars template to bring it up to 16 width while also buffing the stats. Use the last 5 XP to add the infantry equipment MIO to your rifle design or paint over one of the irregular battalions with regular infantry in the division template, whichever you prefer. Use your first 50 pp to appoint the defensive chief of army and make sure everyone is dug in with max entrenchment, appoint your field marshal, give him the defensive trait as soon as the cp becomes available, and either charismatic or org first, again, your choice, as second trait. Once Italy sends you the ultimatum, reject, obviously, and after a day or two they will war dec you. Don't try to attack, your divisions will be under strength but if you stay dug in and rely on the entrenchment bonus you will lose very little material and manpower to Italy's attacks and can begin to build up. At this point it's simply up to you to manage the various aspects of the ongoing defense. Build more units and follow the army focus path taking the right hand branch to max out your manpower, conscription laws, free military factories and some free infantry units. You should be able to build around ten to twelve units of infantry throughout the Italian war, research mountaineers and paint over the irregulars in your division template with mountaineers or regular infantry. Use last stand only if things get bad, if you focus on building up and improving your division template, and number of divisions, you should never be in any real danger and can often take out ~400k Italians for 4-5k of your own people.

If you survive this, join the allies once Germany declares war on Poland and watch the British push the Italians out of Ethiopia, you can help if you want to speed things along but be careful not to over reach. Once Ethiopia is liberated you can send your now very elite army off anywhere you feel like helping out however until Vichy France joins the war you wont be able to get any naval bases. Your options are somewhat limited and Axis submarines combined with not having many transports make it hard to move around but you can still help out and have some fun. Keep one or two divisions at home as Vichy France just seems to join at random and can march straight into your capital. Eventually Ethiopia will leave the Allies and make their own Faction so if you want to take them out I'd advise getting the focus that gives you a war goal on them as it doesn't run out so it's handy to have for when you want it. If you use the war goal as soon as they flip the invasion will be very easy however it can become almost impossible if you let Ethiopia build up again. Do not invite any allies as they will always get a higher war score and steal some land, making the consolidate the Horn of Africa decision impossible.
